content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to update the firmware on the text display modules?
Hello, Updating the firmware on these display modules is not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that firmware updates for display modules within [product_name] components are not supported. This technical limitation prevents users from upgrading firmware themselves, potentially limiting future feature enhancements and affecting overall device management and user satisfaction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to update the display module firmware themselves to access new features or fix issues.
